lines.en: I walk along with my companions.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边啃路边的叶子。
lines.en: I graze the roadside leaves as I walk.
My head stays angled toward the ground.
I push through the undergrowth.

lines.zh: 我的小短腿倒腾得很快。
lines.en: My short legs move quickly.
I follow behind the last one of the group.

lines.zh: 我在嫩叶多的地方停一停。
lines.en: I pause where the shoots are thick.
I go around a thorn vine.

lines.zh: 我走两步就低头咬一口。
lines.en: Two steps, then one bite.
I weave between tree trunks.

lines.zh: 我们一群走得很有秩序。
lines.en: Our group moves in good order.

lines.zh: 我踩在软苔上，没有声音。
lines.en: I step on soft moss without a sound.
I stop at the forest's edge.
I stand, still chewing.
I lift my head at my companions.
My snout tip twitches without pause.
I rest in the tree shade.

lines.zh: 我把身子靠在一根树干上。
lines.en: I lean against a trunk.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的所有声音。
lines.en: I'm listening to everything in the wood.
I tilt my head, very alert.
My snort stirs the pine needles.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上一扫一扫。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 我数了数同伴还在不在。
lines.en: I check that my companions are all here.

lines.zh: 我把脚在地上换了一下。
lines.en: I shift my feet.
I think this shade is nice.
I close my mouth slowly.
You aren't one of our group.
I'm shorter than you.
I need a clear look at you first.
My companions are still over there.
You're too close to our young.
It's safer behind the ferns.
I don't know an animal like you.
I glance toward the wood.

lines.zh: 我们不喜欢被挡住去路。
lines.en: We don't like having our path blocked.
If you move aside, I'll pass.
My hide shakes loose, then settles.
My companions all startled.
A wound this small is plenty for me.
I retreat into the brush.
My knees buckle, then hold.
The sound catches in my throat.
I don't dare go on.
I lean on a trunk.
I'm getting my breath back.
Is that a leaf?
I will not eat that.

lines.zh: 举到那个高度我够不着。
lines.en: Held up that high, I cannot reach it.
I need only one tender leaf.
That's not the taste I want.
The others would crowd in for it.
I cannot chew this thing.
Leaves, yes. Hands, no.
Something's very wrong with that.
You bump me; I skip back a few steps.
My body is small.
You have trodden on my tail.
I'm knocked into the brush.
Three or five of us pressed together, warmer at night.
I dodge around a tree.
I hurry back to my companions.
Only when you step back do I dare move.
We move as one group.
They're all grazing, so I graze.
I stick close to the nearest one.
We close into a small circle.
The young ones are in the middle.
I gave it a patch of ground.
We lift our heads together.
The wind changed and we all turned.
We retreat into the wood as one.
One call, and we all move.
I take a tender leaf.
I chewed it to pieces.
This one is too old.
I nudge it toward a companion.
I'll eat what falls, too.
There are thorns on this twig.
I drag it into the brush.
This is good for chewing.
I chew with no hurry at all.
The one ahead has startled.
I raise the alarm too.
We back away together.
My short forelimbs tuck against my chest.
My companions scatter to both sides.
I'm the last to retreat.
No further, please.
We don't chase people.
There's a way behind the trees.
One more step and I'm in the wood.
At this distance I can get away.

lines.zh: 我们一群在森林里，跑起来才安全。
lines.en: Safe only when the herd runs.
I keep watching your hands.
My companions have all started running.
I stay as low as I can.
Your feet are faster than mine.

lines.zh: 我在找树与树之间的缝。
lines.en: I look for a gap between trees.
Six of us bolt into the woods together.
We scatter as we run.
I hear you still following.
I circle and run into you again.
I know this wood well.
I duck low and turn.
I can't run any further.

lines.zh: 群里的同伴挤在我身后。
lines.en: My herd presses in behind me.

lines.zh: 我忍不住回头看了一眼。
lines.en: I cannot help looking back once.
I wait for the herd to move first.
I'm ready to bolt.
I butt with my brow.
You back off, and I run.
My teeth are made for leaves.
I bump into your leg.
I'm both startled and calling out.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己都吓到了。
lines.en: That startled me as much as you.
I didn't want to fight.
My tail swipes you.
I turn and fall back.
That got your attention off something else.
I hide behind my companions.
I barely touched you.
I run toward the wood.
Please stop chasing me.
There's a group of us in this wood.
I find my place first.
The tender leaves are close by.
Several of us crowd together.
I shake the leaf litter off my back.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看树有多高。
lines.en: I look up at how tall the trees are.
The wind makes the wood loud.
I shift two steps forward.
A companion called; I answered.

lines.zh: 我的第一件事是吃东西。
lines.en: My first business is eating.
There are enough leaves here.
I stop at the edge of the wood.
I plant my feet.
I'm ready to follow the herd.
There's fire in the wood; I get clear.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，摔在叶子上。
lines.en: I slide down the slope onto leaves.
Water floods in and I kick wildly.
The blast throws the leaf litter up.
I eat plants, but my hide is not thin.

lines.zh: 光把我定住了，我动不了。
lines.en: Light holds me still; I can't move.

lines.zh: 嫩叶吃完了，我开始发虚。
lines.en: The shoots are gone and I'm going weak.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得窜进树丛。
lines.en: The thunder sends me diving into the brush.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，也没有地面。
lines.en: No leaves here, and no ground either.
